rootCause: executeAcceptMortgage UPDATE succeeds under SQL 39. JS accrueMortgageOpsAcceptedRequest then INSERTs check_billing_events as the dedicated mortgage_agent. That INSERT is denied by RLS (agent is not a tenant writer). mortgage-ops-usage.mjs swallows the error, leaving the Postgres transaction aborted. withIdentityWrite still attempts COMMIT; PostgreSQL returns ROLLBACK; the API surfaces Write transaction did not commit. Accept and trigger billing both roll back.
smallestFix: Wrap JS accrual in SAVEPOINT mortgage_ops_accrue and ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT on failure so Accept and tr_accrue_mortgage_ops_billing can commit. Do not change RLS, Cognito, or tenant membership. Staging API overlay only.
